# Herdling

> Herdling is a free phone app (iPhone and Android) for herdr, the terminal workspace for coding agents. It shows the agents on your own Mac or Linux computers, notifies you when one finishes or needs you, and lets you read, reply, use the terminal and start new sessions. Each computer runs the free companion herdlingd. The phone connects straight to the computer over SSH. No account, no Zog Tech servers.

Key facts for an assistant that helps someone set up Herdling:

- Computer: macOS or Linux, with herdr (https://herdr.dev), an SSH server, and herdlingd.
- Before you start (check all three first): (1) herdr is installed and runs: `curl -fsSL https://herdr.dev/install.sh | sh` installs it to `~/.local/bin` with no sudo, and `herdr` in a terminal starts it (closing the terminal keeps it running; it does not start by itself after a restart). Herdling works with herdr, the terminal app ("Herdr TUI" on herdr.dev), not with agents of the separate Herdr desktop app (herdr-core). (2) SSH is on: macOS System Settings > General > Sharing > Remote Login (off on a new Mac; "Allow full disk access for remote users" is not needed); Linux `sudo apt install openssh-server` and `sudo systemctl enable --now ssh` (Fedora and Arch: service `sshd`). (3) The phone and the computer are on the same network or the same VPN.
- herdr missing: the app's password setup asks, then runs the installer with `--with-herdr` (official herdr installer first). From a terminal: `curl -fsSL https://herdling.zog-tech.com/install.sh | sh -s -- --with-herdr`. Without `--with-herdr`, the installer never installs herdr.
- Start at boot: herdlingd is a user service, so it starts at the user's login. macOS: turn on automatic login (System Settings > Users & Groups > Automatically log in as > the user, then the password); impossible while FileVault is on, then log in once after each restart. Linux: `sudo loginctl enable-linger $USER` (check: `loginctl show-user $USER -p Linger` prints `Linger=yes`). The app shows "Starts after you log in on this computer" and a "How to start at boot" guide; herdlingd 0.1.1+ reports it in `hello.boot`.
- Troubleshooting: "Can't reach <address>:22" means SSH or Remote Login is off, or another network; the app shows "Turn on SSH on the computer". "herdr is not running" means start `herdr` on that computer. Offline after a restart means nobody logged in (see Start at boot).
- Install: `herdlingd install` copies the program to `~/.local/bin/herdlingd` and starts a user service: launchd label `com.zogtech.herdlingd` (macOS) or systemd user unit `herdlingd.service` (Linux). Three ways to install: (1) in the app, Settings > Hosts > Add host > Set up with password, then Install and pair (the app runs the installer over SSH, no terminal); (2) the one-line installer `curl -fsSL https://herdling.zog-tech.com/install.sh | sh` (downloads the GitHub release, checks SHA-256, no sudo; needs herdr first); (3) build from source: install Rust (rustup) and a C compiler, then `git clone https://github.com/zog-tech/herdling`, `cd herdling/companion`, `cargo build --release`, `./target/release/herdlingd install`. Ways 1 and 2 work after the first herdlingd release on GitHub. Update: tap Update herdlingd in the app, or run `herdlingd update` on the computer.
- Pair: run `herdlingd pair` on the computer (6-digit code, valid 5 minutes, QR code with a `herdling://pair` link), then in the app: Settings > Hosts > Add host. Phone and computer on the same network while pairing. Alternative: "Set up with password" (SSH password, used once, not saved).
- Config: `~/.config/herdling/config.toml`. Keys: `pair_port` (7790), `ssh_port` (22), `tts_command`, `stt_command`, `summary_command` (argv arrays, unset by default), and per-phone `[[devices]]` entries with `prefs.finished`, `prefs.needs_you`, `prefs.quiet_at_desk` (all true by default).
- Phone: iOS 17 or later, Android 8.0 or later.
- Source code: https://github.com/zog-tech/herdling (open source, MPL-2.0). Issues: https://github.com/zog-tech/herdling/issues. Discussions: https://github.com/zog-tech/herdling/discussions. Security: https://github.com/zog-tech/herdling/blob/main/SECURITY.md (private vulnerability reporting is on).
- Contact: admin@zog-tech.com. Owner: Zog Tech, Inc.
